messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020): forecast update and revised package
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for agreeing to the 1500 ppm target. This gives us a clear basis for the improvement plan requested in our letter of 21 September.

The forecast for part:310020 increased by 20% (fc:310020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

The package covers 15900 pieces per year over 12 months from 2027-01-01. It gives your plant a stable, plannable load, which should ease workload and planning during your restructuring. We understand that margin matters to you right now. Could you tell us which production or packaging variant would let you meet the attached price, and what your earliest lead time would be?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
